edges.notes: Landlock is a Linux Security Module enforcing filesystem access rules from unprivileged processes.
Landlock is an LSM implementation; it plugs into the LSM framework alongside SELinux/AppArmor-class modules.
Userspace uses the documented Landlock syscall ABI and helper patterns from libc.
Typical GNU/Linux programs invoke Landlock syscalls via glibc wrappers.
musl-based Linux userlands may use Landlock with musl syscall wrappers.
Pod security contexts and node policies may interact with LSM classes on Linux workers.
